title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-04-06
body:
Weekly private-deployments notes (standup + ops log) - 2026-04-06

Context: focusing on VPC/on-prem installs for three active customers this sprint. Main goals: finish air-gapped install automation for Customer A, unblock Customer B networking, validation checklist for Customer C pre-prod.

Today
- Quick sync 09:30 - went over current customer blockers and rollout plan.
- Dry-run of air-gapped install on local lab VM (ubuntu 22.04) - saw 2 issues: checksum mismatch for model artifact fetch step; systemd service for inference-worker failing with permission denied on /var/run/rdw-cache.
- Networking call with Customer B at 11:00 to review VPC peering config. Customer B changed TGW routing unexpectedly; we escalated to their infra lead.
- Created a temporary fallback policy for hosted -> dedicated routing when private capacity not ready (JIRA-PRIV-781).

Standup snippets (round-robin updates)
- Priya: finish checksum fix for artifact fetch; create clearer preflight checklist for air-gapped installs; follow up with security on KMS integration doc.
- Liam: working on service user perms and systemd unit override; testing container hooks for non-root deploys.
- Aisha: validating k8s manifests for on-prem package; identified nodeSelector mismatch in our templating for Customer C.
- Diego: prepping automation test matrix for long-running KV cache; repro for cache corruption seen in lab.
- Marta: collecting logs from Customer A lab run; forwarding to runtime team for deeper kernel selection debugging.

Blockers (current)
- Customer A: artifact checksum mismatch during air-gapped artifact load (likely packaging script issue). Blocks initial install smoke tests. Ticket: CONFLUENCE-PL-4523 + follow-up JIRA-ART-990.
- Customer B: TGW routing change prevents peering to our transit VPC; requires their infra to push route change or provide alternative egress. Blocked on their infra lead ETA (stalled ~48h).
- Customer C: nodeSelector mismatch causing pods to be scheduled on wrong tainted nodes in on-prem cluster; mitigation is to patch Helm values but need sign-off from SRE.
- Infra / Permissions: systemd unit failing under non-root in some environments; we need an official non-root runbook and test matrix covering debian/ubuntu/rhel variants.

Action items
- Priya: patch packaging script + run new checksum build by EOD (owner). (JIRA: JIRA-ART-990).
- Liam: create systemd non-root runbook + submit PR to install scripts repo by 2026-04-08.
- Aisha: update Helm templates to support explicit nodeSelector override and document in customer C runbook.
- Diego: reproduce KV cache corruption locally and add automated test case in CI.
- Marta: collect and upload full runtime logs + perf traces to linked GH issue; tag runtime team for triage.

Decisions / Notes
- We will hold off automated rollout to Customer B until TGW routing is confirmed. Temporary workaround: offer them a hosted-proxy route (with audit) if they agree; coordinate with sales on cost + privacy implications.
- Prioritize checksum fix for artifacts since it blocks all air-gapped installs.
- Add a preflight checklist item to verify time sync and CA bundle for all on-prem installs (seen two separate failures where CA bundle missing caused TLS to fail during artifact validation).

Risks / Open questions
- Do we need to sign the artifacts with an offline key for air-gapped installs to avoid checksum drift in customer packaging flows? (security input needed)
- How to better detect and surface TGW changes from customers proactively? Can we add route validation to our preflight scanner?

Next meetings
- Follow-up with Customer A validation call: 2026-04-07 10:00 PT.
- Internal triage for runtime traces: 2026-04-06 15:00 PT.

Quick logs / commands run (lab)
- sha256sum model-v1.tar.gz -> mismatch seen: expected 3a7f... got 9c2b...
- journalctl -u rdw-inference-worker -n 200 -> permission denied on /var/run/rdw-cache at start, process exits.

References
- CONFLUENCE-PL-4523 (air-gapped packaging details)
- JIRA-PRIV-781 (fallback routing policy)
- github.com/redwood-inference/private-install-scripts/pull/42 (WIP systemd fixes)

Notes to self
- follow up with Security (KMS/HSM) re: offline signing by 2026-04-10.
- add explicit test step in CI to run on ubuntu:22.04 and rhel:8 matrix for systemd permission coverage.

notes: Informal working doc: capture standup chatter + quick triage. Will migrate resolved items to Confluence / Jira as needed. Contains rough commands and partial outputs.
